captions.caption: A man walks through a dense, green forest.
The man approaches a trap on the ground.
He squats down to check the forest trap.
A close-up shows him handling a wooden trap.
He pulls a caught rat out of the trap.
He holds the captured rat by its tail.
He resets the wooden trap on the soil.
He lifts the rat high for a better look.
He prepares to move on with his catch.
The rat dangles from the man's hand.
He stands up from the forest floor.
He begins walking away from the trap site.
He walks uphill through the thick vegetation.

He navigates through the leafy jungle path.
He moves steadily through the forest terrain.
He continues his journey deeper into the woods.
He walks past large trees and ferns.
He enters a new section of the forest.
He approaches another trap near a rock.
He reaches down to check the second trap.
He extracts another rat from the rock trap.
He holds up the newly caught rat.
He examines the animal before moving on.
He adds the rat to his carrying stick.
He secures the latest catch to the bunch.
He stands up with all his gathered rats.
He prepares to head back to camp.
He walks through the uneven forest ground.
He descends a small slope in the jungle.
Smoke rises from a small forest hut.
A wide shot shows the simple leaf shelter.
The man roasts the rats over an open fire.
A close-up shows meat sizzling on skewers.
He turns the skewers to cook evenly.
Smoke billows from the wood fire.
He adjusts the position of the skewers.
The rats turn brown over the hot coals.
He blows on the fire to increase heat.
Orange flames lick the roasting meat.
He carefully watches the cooking process.
The meat is dark and well-roasted.
He begins to remove the food from fire.
He prepares the meal on banana leaves.
He sits down to eat his forest meal.
He takes a bite of the roasted rat.
He chews the meat with satisfaction.
He pulls a piece of meat from the bone.
He continues eating in his shelter.
He enjoys the results of his hunt.
He looks briefly toward the camera.
He picks more meat off the skewer.
He eats another piece of the roast.
He remains seated on the leafy ground.
He chews slowly while looking around.
He holds the skewer with one hand.
He continues his meal near the fire.
He finishes another portion of meat.
He sits comfortably under the leaf roof.
Smoke drifts past as he keeps eating.
